based_on: Today's signals: higher living costs, policy changes, market uncertainty, and long-term investment decisions
question: Kung stewardship means planning wisely for costs, deadlines, at uncertainty, kailan nagiging responsible foresight ang paghahanda—and kailan naman ito nagiging fear-driven attempt na kontrolin ang future na dapat din nating ipagkatiwala sa Diyos?

verses.text: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself.
